scripts._comment:dev:tsc: Both the backend (tsx) and Vite import workspace packages from their dist/, so without this watcher an edit in packages/* is invisible until dev restarts. Watching the whole solution also surfaces type errors live, and new packages are picked up through tsconfig references.
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

_comment:allowScripts: npm 11+ blocks or warns about dependency install scripts nobody approved. Approve one with `npm install-scripts approve <pkg>`, then remove the @version it pins so upgrades stay approved. esbuild's script only checks its binary. better-sqlite3 is denied on purpose: since v13 it ships N-API prebuilds for linux x64/arm64 (glibc and musl) and loads them first, so its implicit `node-gyp rebuild` only needs python3, which the slim image lacks, and builds nothing. A native addon without a bundled prebuild would NEED its script: if it is blocked, the package installs without its binding and the app crashes at startup, not at build.
